result.brief: 提出自参考世界模型奖励SPAR，用静态片段作内容匹配基线评估预测误差，并做时空奖励细化，提升文生视频与图生视频续写的物理合理性。
result.reason: Uses latent world-model prediction errors as inference-time reward for physical plausibility in video generation, with spatiotemporal reward refinement; directly targets video world-model signals and video generation.
